description: This file contains unit tests for the inline container serialization and deserialization in the Caffe2 framework, including save/load, multi-threaded access, error handling, and allocator usage.

classes.name: TestAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that tracks allocated bytes, used for testing allocator behavior.

methods.name: TestAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory and tracks the total allocated bytes.

methods.name: TestAllocator::raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns the raw deleter function for the allocator.

methods.name: TestAllocator::getAllocatedBytes
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes allocated.
